rules: Hermes may claim a READY ai-os-repair issue without founder input when the issue does not require production, live billing, customer delivery, secret, permission or destructive changes.
Codex implements the repair and returns changed files, commit SHA, tests and evidence to the issue or linked pull request.
Codex cannot mark the parent task COMPLETE.
A new commit SHA must pass CI and receive fresh independent Grok review before VERIFIED or COMPLETE.
If the repair reaches a founder-gated action, set AWAITING_APPROVAL and preserve the original task context so work resumes after approval.
